title: Separate a repaired marginal from an independent fresh replicate
statement: With one old record ofNindependent unknown Bernoulli coordinates and information about each bias only through counted calls to its oracle, exact conditional fresh-product output requires Enewcalls>=N. For biases p_i=1/2+/-alpha,one old sample and NOadditional parameter-dependent information, requiring the full(X,Y)law withinTVdeltaof two independent product samples for every parameter vector yields the fair-sign-prior average lower bound N[1-4alpha²-(2/alpha+4)delta]_+. Thus at least one instance incurs this cost; alpha1/16,delta0.01gives999N/1600. This is a full joint-law information contract, not an obstruction to correlated exact-Q repair. CopyingNfairbits is marginally exact but distance1-2^-Nfrom two independent traces.
